description: This file provides a zap-based logger compatible with gRPC's logging interface, including level mapping, configuration options, and integration with zap's SugaredLogger.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Adapts zap's SugaredLogger to implement gRPC's grpclog.LoggerV2 interface, providing logging methods with level control.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Interface for configuring the Logger options.

classes.name: printer
classes.description: Helper struct to implement Print, Printf, and Println methods for different log levels.

methods.name: NewLogger
methods.description: Creates a new Logger instance with optional configurations.

methods.name: WithDebug
methods.description: Returns an Option that configures the logger to output at Debug level.
